```yaml
name: Analyze

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/v*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/v*

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Super Linter
        uses: super-linter/super-linter@v8.5.0

      - name: Instrument with OpenTelemetry
        uses: plengauer/opentelemetry-github/actions/instrument/job@v5.45.1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: true
          secrets_to_redact: GITHUB_TOKEN,NODE_AUTH_TOKEN
          self_monitoring: true
          self_monitoring_anonymize: false
          debug: false
          __kill_switch: false
          __job_status: true
          __job_matrix: false
          __job_id: ${{ github.job }}

      - name: Set SHAs for Nx
        uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v4
        with:
          gh-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          main-branch-name: main
          remote: origin
          set-environment-variables-for-job: true
          error-on-no-successful-workflow: false
          fallback-sha: ''
          last-successful-event: ''
          working-directory: .
          workflow-id: analyze
          use-previous-merge-group-commit: false
```

yaml:
name: Analyze

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/v*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/v*

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Super Linter
        uses: super-linter/super-linter@v8.5.0

      - name: Instrument with OpenTelemetry
        uses: plengauer/opentelemetry-github/actions/instrument/job@v5.45.1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          cache: true
          secrets_to_redact: GITHUB_TOKEN,NODE_AUTH_TOKEN
          self_monitoring: true
          self_monitoring_anonymize: false
          debug: false
          __kill_switch: false
          __job_status: true
          __job_matrix: false
          __job_id: ${{ github.job }}

      - name: Set SHAs for Nx
        uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v4
        with:
          gh-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          main-branch-name: main
          remote: origin
          set-environment-variables-for-job: true
          error-on-no-successful-workflow: false
          fallback-sha: ''
          last-successful-event: ''
          working-directory: .
          workflow-id: analyze
          use-previous-merge-group-commit: false
